meta.section: Section 4 - Container Images and Build File

results.remediation: Add a USER instruction to the Dockerfile with a non-root, non-zero UID. Example: RUN groupadd -r appgroup && useradd -r -g appgroup appuser USER appuser
results.title: Ensure a user for the container has been created

results.details: [INFO] 4.2 - Manual check required. Verify all FROM instructions reference images from an approved registry (e.g. Docker Official Images, verified publishers, or your internal registry).
results.remediation: Define an approved base image list. Enforce via Dockerfile linting (hadolint) or admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper). Enable Docker Content Trust.
results.title: Ensure containers use only trusted base images

results.details: [INFO] 4.3 - Manual check required. Inspect each image layer with docker history --no-trunc and audit installed packages.
results.remediation: Use multi-stage builds to keep final images minimal. Start from distroless or Alpine base images. Remove package manager caches: RUN apt-get install ... && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
results.title: Ensure unnecessary packages are not installed in the container

results.details: [INFO] 4.4 - Manual check required. Verify images are scanned with a vulnerability scanner and rebuilt when CVEs are published.
results.remediation: Integrate docker scout, Trivy, or Grype into CI pipelines. Set up automated rebuilds when base image CVEs are published. Pin base image digests and update them on a regular schedule.
results.title: Ensure images are scanned and rebuilt to include security patches

results.remediation: Set the environment variable before running docker commands: export DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1 Add it to /etc/environment or the docker service unit for persistent enforcement.
results.title: Ensure Content trust for Docker is Enabled

results.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction to every Dockerfile: HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --retries=3 CMD curl -f http://localhost/health || exit 1
results.title: Ensure HEALTHCHECK instructions have been added to container images

results.details: [PASS] 4.7 - No standalone update instructions found in image history.
results.remediation: Always combine RUN apt-get update with apt-get install in the same RUN instruction to prevent Docker layer cache from serving stale package lists: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y <packages>
results.title: Ensure update instructions are not used alone in the Dockerfile
Ensure setuid and setgid permissions are removed in images

results.details: [PASS] 4.9 - No ADD instructions found. COPY used correctly.
results.remediation: Replace ADD with COPY in all Dockerfiles. ADD is only needed for: (1) auto-extracting tar archives, (2) fetching remote URLs. For everything else, COPY is explicit and safer.
results.title: Ensure COPY is used instead of ADD in Dockerfiles

results.details: [INFO] 4.10 - Manual check required. Scan image history and Dockerfiles for hardcoded credentials, API keys, or tokens.
results.remediation: Use Docker BuildKit secrets for build-time secrets: RUN --mount=type=secret,id=mysecret cat /run/secrets/mysecret Use environment variables or a secrets manager (Vault, AWS SSM) at runtime. Scan images with truffleHog or gitleaks before pushing to a registry.
results.title: Ensure secrets are not stored in Dockerfiles

results.details: [INFO] 4.11 - Manual check required. Verify all packages are installed from trusted, pinned sources with signature verification enabled.
results.remediation: Pin package versions in Dockerfiles: RUN apt-get install -y nginx=1.24.0-1 Verify GPG signatures for third-party packages before installing. Use a private mirror or Artifactory to control what packages are available.
results.title: Ensure only verified packages are installed in the container

results.details: [INFO] 4.12 - Manual check required. Verify that all images and artifacts are cryptographically signed and signatures are validated before use.
results.remediation: Enable Docker Content Trust (DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1). Use Notary or Sigstore/cosign to sign and verify images: cosign sign --key cosign.key registry/image:tag cosign verify --key cosign.pub registry/image:tag
results.title: Ensure all signed artifacts are validated
